GAME_DAY_STATUS: p_no_participation is BEFORE game-day status is known. A player the evidence resolves ACTIVE is given p_no_participation = 0 and phi from the played distribution: a declared, untestable-here assumption (PREREG_PM2 s.2).

MEANING.phi_quantiles: the per-world participation factor on a 101-point grid: the share of his normal role a player keeps, net of ordinary week-to-week dispersion
MEANING.p_early_exit: P(last on-field play before 75% of club plays | played); already inside phi
